name: AGENT-TEST Product Points
test_purpose: Baseline ProductPoints (VIP eligibility) for loyalty suites 075/083 + mixed-cart VCST-5101 (pre-existing).

name: AGENT-TEST PP Single-SKU Laptop
test_purpose: VCST-5135 resolution model: the highest-priority eligible+active all-group program. For ORG_USER it WINS (pri 80) → its SKU LT-001 (factor 500) earns 500×price while non-winning programs' SKUs earn the default factor 1. Proves a winning program's factor overrides the default.

name: AGENT-TEST PP Multi-SKU Basket
test_purpose: VCST-5135: MULTI program (factors QA-LOY-MULTI-A=50 / QA-LOY-MULTI-B=25). Loses to ALL (pri 80) for ORG_USER → its SKUs earn default unless MULTI is made the winner. Multi-SKU factor fixture.

name: AGENT-TEST PP VIP Exclusive
test_purpose: VCST-5135 eligibility: VIP-only (pri 100 > ALL 80). For a VIP user it WINS → WH-001 (factor 100) overrides; for a non-VIP user VIP is not a candidate → WH-001 earns the default. Proves group eligibility decides candidacy + higher-priority eligible program wins.

name: AGENT-TEST PP Wholesaler Tier
test_purpose: VCST-5135 eligibility: Wholesaler-only (pri 90 > ALL 80). For a Wholesaler user it WINS → QA-TIER-001 (factor 250) overrides; non-wholesaler → QA-TIER earns the default. Group-scoped winner.

name: AGENT-TEST PP Future Window
test_purpose: VCST-5135 lifecycle gate: TOP priority (200) + active + factor on QA-PACK-001 (75), but start date +7d → NOT a valid candidate, so it never wins despite top priority. Its SKU earns the default. Proves the future window — not priority — is the sole loss reason.

name: AGENT-TEST PP Expired Window
test_purpose: VCST-5135 lifecycle gate: TOP priority (200) + active + factor on QA-LOW-001 (75), but end date -7d (expired) → never a valid candidate. SKU earns default. Proves the expired window is the sole loss reason.

name: AGENT-TEST PP Inactive With Factors
test_purpose: VCST-5135 inactive gate: TOP priority (200) + factor on QA-LOY-INACT-001 (500) but isActive=false → never a candidate. SKU earns default. Proves the active flag is the sole loss reason even at top priority.

name: AGENT-TEST PP Priority High
test_purpose: VCST-5135: competitor program on the shared SKU QA-LOY-PRIO-001 (factor 999, pri 70 < ALL 80). LOY_PP_ALL also factors this SKU (500). When made the winner it overrides; used for priority-resolution tests (single winner, no stacking — confirmed live).

name: AGENT-TEST PP Zero Points BVA
test_purpose: VCST-5135 boundary (BVA): factor=0 on QA-LOY-ZERO-001. When ZERO is the winning program its SKU earns 0×price = 0 (override to nothing) — distinct from the default factor 1. Lower-boundary of the factor value.

name: AGENT-TEST PP Multi Localized
test_purpose: VCST-5135: localized program name (es-ES) on dedicated SKU QA-LOY-LOCALE-001 (factor 10). Exercises the Localized names field; earning observable when LOCALIZED is the winner.
